articles.title: Over 5,000 rescuers deployed after M7.0 earthquake hit China's Xizang
articles.titleCn: 中国西藏发生7.0级地震，5000多名救援人员已部署
articles.summary: Rescue operations are now in the critical "golden period." More than 5,000 personnel from various rescue teams have been deployed across the affected area, conducting door-to-door and site-by-site searches.
articles.summaryCn: 中国西藏那曲市巴青县发生7.0级地震，造成16人死亡、76人受伤，5000多名救援人员已部署，1.2万余名居民被安全转移，各方救援物资和资金迅速到位。

paragraphs.en:
/Xinhua
Relief supplies sent to affected areas
Central, regional, municipal and county authorities have sent supplies including prefabricated houses, tents, quilts and winter clothing. The National Commission for Disaster Reduction and the Ministry of Emergency Management raised the national natural disaster relief response to Level III. Insulated tents, winter coats and folding beds are among 10,000 items of central relief supplies {{12}}, with a separate pool of 43,000 essentials, like mobile toilets, heating stoves, food and fuel, provided by the Red Cross Society of China, the China Charity Federation and other organizations. The Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management jointly allocated 50 million yuan (about $7.5 million) to support rescue operations and assistance to affected residents, while the National Development and Reform Commission {{13}} an additional 30 million yuan from the central budget to help restore damaged infrastructure and public service facilities. The Organization Department of the Communist Party of China Central Committee has also allocated 25 million yuan in emergency relief funds, while the National Health Commission dispatched medical experts.
paragraphs.cn:
/新华社
救援物资运往受灾地区
中央、自治区、市和县当局已发送包括活动板房、帐篷、被子和冬衣在内的物资。国家减灾委员会和应急管理部将国家自然灾害救助应急响应提升至三级。在分配的1万件中央救灾物资中，包括保温帐篷、冬季外套和折叠床，另有4.3万件基本生活用品，如移动厕所、取暖炉、食品和燃料，由中国红十字会、中华慈善总会和其他组织提供。财政部和应急管理部联合拨付5000万元人民币（约合750万美元），用于支持救援行动和对受灾居民的救助，而国家发展和改革委员会从中央预算中额外拨出3000万元人民币，用于帮助恢复受损的基础设施和公共服务设施。中共中央组织部还拨付了2500万元人民币的紧急救灾资金，同时国家卫生健康委员会派遣了医疗专家。

paragraphs.en:
Six medical teams from Xizang, bringing emergency equipment, medicines and specialized vehicles, are also on site. Medical teams in neighboring provinces are on standby and emergency blood supply mechanism has been activated. Aftershocks possible
Analysis shows the earthquake {{14}} lay within the Qiangtang block of the Qinghai-Xizang Plateau, driven by {{15}} faulting – horizontal crust stretching. Six earthquakes of magnitude 7.0 or above have occurred within the Qiangtang block since 1900, the largest a 7.5 in Shuanghu County in 1997. But no quake of magnitude 7.0 or above had been recorded within 200 kilometers of the latest epicenter, according to the China Earthquake Networks Center (CENC), which described the event as "a release of energy stored in the block."
Experts say the coming days may see aftershocks.
paragraphs.cn:
来自西藏的六支医疗队携带应急设备、药品和专用车辆也已抵达现场。邻省的医疗队处于待命状态，紧急血液供应机制已启动。可能发生余震
分析显示，此次地震震中位于青藏高原羌塘地块内，由伸展断层作用——水平地壳拉伸——驱动。自1900年以来，羌塘地块内已发生六次7.0级及以上地震，最大的是1997年双湖县的7.5级地震。但据中国地震台网中心（CENC）称，在最新震中200公里范围内没有记录到7.0级及以上地震，该中心将此次事件描述为“地块内储存能量的释放”。
专家表示，未来几天可能发生余震。

paragraphs.en: Preliminary assessments indicate the overall risk of large-scale geological disasters such as collapses and landslides is relatively low, though small-scale ones remain possible on some steep slopes and along roads.
paragraphs.cn: 初步评估表明，崩塌和滑坡等大规模地质灾害的总体风险相对较低，但在一些陡坡和道路沿线仍可能发生小规模灾害。

articles.fullText:
Firefighters set up tents in a village in Maru Township, Baqen County, Nagqu City, southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region, October 23, 2026. /Xinhua
Southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region has deployed more than 5,000 rescue personnel following a 7.0-magnitude earthquake that struck Baqen County in Nagqu City at around 10:33 p.m. Thursday.
The quake left 16 people dead and 76 injured, with 339 homes collapsed or damaged. By 3 p.m. Friday, 12,489 residents had been safely relocated. No one is reported missing after three rounds of comprehensive checks, according to the Baqen earthquake emergency command center.
With rescue operations in their critical "golden period," teams are scouring the area door-to-door and site-by-site.
Rescue and relief efforts underway
Shortly after the disaster, the PLA Western Theater Command activated its emergency response mechanism. By 4 p.m. Friday, over 400 PLA and People's Armed Police personnel alongside more than 50 vehicles had been deployed to treat the injured, erect tents and relocate locals. Two temporary medical stations and two hot-food distribution stations are operational.
The National Work Safety Emergency Rescue Center dispatched teams, comprising 34 personnel and 15 vehicles, equipped with more than 100 reconnaissance and heavy-lift drones, life detectors, demolition and shoring equipment and satellite communications to assess secondary-disaster risks.
China Mobile has repaired damaged base stations, restoring communication networks back to pre-earthquake levels.
Residents gathered in front of relief tents, Maru Township, Baqen County, Nagqu City, southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region, October 23, 2026. /Xinhua
Relief supplies sent to affected areas
Central, regional, municipal and county authorities have sent supplies including prefabricated houses, tents, quilts and winter clothing.
The National Commission for Disaster Reduction and the Ministry of Emergency Management raised the national natural disaster relief response to Level III.
Insulated tents, winter coats and folding beds are among 10,000 items of central relief supplies allocated, with a separate pool of 43,000 essentials, like mobile toilets, heating stoves, food and fuel, provided by the Red Cross Society of China, the China Charity Federation and other organizations.
The Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management jointly allocated 50 million yuan (about $7.5 million) to support rescue operations and assistance to affected residents, while the National Development and Reform Commission earmarked an additional 30 million yuan from the central budget to help restore damaged infrastructure and public service facilities.
The Organization Department of the Communist Party of China Central Committee has also allocated 25 million yuan in emergency relief funds, while the National Health Commission dispatched medical experts. Six medical teams from Xizang, bringing emergency equipment, medicines and specialized vehicles, are also on site. Medical teams in neighboring provinces are on standby and emergency blood supply mechanism has been activated.
Aftershocks possible
Analysis shows the earthquake epicenter lay within the Qiangtang block of the Qinghai-Xizang Plateau, driven by extensional faulting – horizontal crust stretching.
Six earthquakes of magnitude 7.0 or above have occurred within the Qiangtang block since 1900, the largest a 7.5 in Shuanghu County in 1997. But no quake of magnitude 7.0 or above had been recorded within 200 kilometers of the latest epicenter, according to the China Earthquake Networks Center (CENC), which described the event as "a release of energy stored in the block."
Experts say the coming days may see aftershocks. Preliminary assessments indicate the overall risk of large-scale geological disasters such as collapses and landslides is relatively low, though small-scale ones remain possible on some steep slopes and along roads.

articles.title: China issues guidelines to integrate sci-tech, industry innovation
articles.titleCn: 中国发布关于推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合的指导意见
articles.summary: China issues guidelines to integrate sci-tech, industry innovation
articles.summaryCn: 中国发布指导意见，旨在推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合，通过六方面具体措施培育新质生产力、建设现代化产业体系。

paragraphs.en: China has released a set of guidelines on promoting the deep {{0}} of scientific and technological innovation and industrial innovation. Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council, this document provides a {{1}} {{2}} for advancing the deep integration of sci-tech and industrial innovations. Humanoid robots pick up components on a production line in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, east China, October 19, 2026. The guidelines call for deepening the implementation of the innovation-driven development strategy to {{3}} new quality productive forces and build a modern industrial system. They focus on establishing an enterprise-led, multi-stakeholder {{4}} framework for integrated industry-academia-research innovation, creating a mutually {{5}} dynamic between technological advancement and industrial growth. This document is of great {{6}} for {{7}} high-level sci-tech {{8}} and strength, {{9}} and developing new quality productive forces, building China into a leading country in science and technology, and advancing Chinese modernization, an official with the Ministry of Science and Technology said. It highlights the necessity to {{10}} {{11}} via reform, requiring that sci-tech innovation should be strengthened with an application-oriented approach while industrial development should clearly define its sci-tech innovation tasks.
paragraphs.cn: 中国发布了一系列关于推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合的指导意见。该文件由中共中央办公厅和国务院办公厅印发，为推进科技创新与产业创新深度融合提供了全面蓝图。2026年10月19日，在中国东部浙江省杭州市，人形机器人在生产线上拾取零部件。指导意见提出，要深入实施创新驱动发展战略，培育新质生产力，建设现代化产业体系。指导意见聚焦于建立以企业为主导、多方参与的产学研融合创新协作框架，形成技术进步与产业增长相互促进的动态格局。科技部一位官员表示，该文件对于加快实现高水平科技自立自强、培育和发展新质生产力、建设科技强国以及推进中国式现代化具有重要意义。文件强调必须通过改革激发活力，要求以应用为导向加强科技创新，同时产业发展应明确其科技创新任务。

paragraphs.en: The document specifies {{12}} measures in six areas, namely {{13}} connecting the innovation chain with the industrial chain, supporting the building of a modern industrial system with the supply of high-quality sci-tech achievements, strengthening enterprise-led industry-academia-research collaborative innovation, improving the efficiency of coordinated {{14}} of innovation resources, fostering a sound {{15}} and expanding the space for deep integration. The official noted that the translation of sci-tech achievements into practical productive forces is {{16}} in spawning new industries and driving industrial transformation. Therefore, it is necessary to promptly apply innovation achievements to industries and industrial chains. The document puts forward three measures in this regard: enhancing the self-reliance and controllability of industrial chains through breakthroughs in key technologies, cultivating and expanding emerging industries and future industries via original and {{17}} sci-tech innovation, and transforming and upgrading traditional industries through the application of advanced technologies. The official underlined the significance of strengthening enterprises' principal role in innovation. The document outlines three measures regarding this aim, which are enhancing corporate innovation capabilities, accelerating the development of sci-tech enterprises and promoting greater {{18}} among innovators. To improve the allocation of innovation resources, it stipulates measures to foster a virtuous cycle among science, industry and finance, enhance coordinated talent development and utilization, and build integrated innovation platforms.
paragraphs.cn: 文件明确了六个方面的具体措施，即无缝衔接创新链与产业链、以高质量科技成果供给支撑现代化产业体系建设、强化以企业为主导的产学研协同创新、提高创新资源统筹配置效率、营造良好生态以及拓展深度融合空间。该官员指出，科技成果转化为现实生产力体现在催生新产业和推动产业转型上。因此，有必要及时将创新成果应用于产业和产业链。文件在这方面提出了三项措施：通过关键核心技术突破增强产业链自主可控能力，通过原创性和颠覆性科技创新培育壮大新兴产业和未来产业，以及通过应用先进技术转型升级传统产业。该官员强调了强化企业创新主体地位的重要意义。文件围绕这一目标提出了三项措施，即增强企业创新能力、加快科技企业发展以及促进创新主体之间更大协同。为改善创新资源配置，文件规定了促进科技、产业和金融良性循环、加强人才协调开发和利用以及建设集成创新平台等措施。

articles.fullText:
China has released a set of guidelines on promoting the deep integration of scientific and technological innovation and industrial innovation.
Issued by the General Office of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council, this document provides a comprehensive blueprint for advancing the deep integration of sci-tech and industrial innovations.
Humanoid robots pick up components on a production line in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, east China, October 19, 2026. 
The guidelines call for deepening the implementation of the innovation-driven development strategy to foster new quality productive forces and build a modern industrial system. They focus on establishing an enterprise-led, multi-stakeholder collaborative framework for integrated industry-academia-research innovation, creating a mutually reinforcing dynamic between technological advancement and industrial growth.
This document is of great significance for accelerating high-level sci-tech self-reliance and strength, cultivating and developing new quality productive forces, building China into a leading country in science and technology, and advancing Chinese modernization, an official with the Ministry of Science and Technology said.
It highlights the necessity to stimulate vitality via reform, requiring that sci-tech innovation should be strengthened with an application-oriented approach while industrial development should clearly define its sci-tech innovation tasks.
The document specifies concrete measures in six areas, namely seamlessly connecting the innovation chain with the industrial chain, supporting the building of a modern industrial system with the supply of high-quality sci-tech achievements, strengthening enterprise-led industry-academia-research collaborative innovation, improving the efficiency of coordinated allocation of innovation resources, fostering a sound ecosystem and expanding the space for deep integration.
The official noted that the translation of sci-tech achievements into practical productive forces is manifested in spawning new industries and driving industrial transformation. Therefore, it is necessary to promptly apply innovation achievements to industries and industrial chains.
The document puts forward three measures in this regard: enhancing the self-reliance and controllability of industrial chains through breakthroughs in key technologies, cultivating and expanding emerging industries and future industries via original and disruptive sci-tech innovation, and transforming and upgrading traditional industries through the application of advanced technologies.
The official underlined the significance of strengthening enterprises' principal role in innovation. The document outlines three measures regarding this aim, which are enhancing corporate innovation capabilities, accelerating the development of sci-tech enterprises and promoting greater synergy among innovators.
To improve the allocation of innovation resources, it stipulates measures to foster a virtuous cycle among science, industry and finance, enhance coordinated talent development and utilization, and build integrated innovation platforms.

文件明确了六个方面的具体措施，即无缝衔接创新链与产业链、以高质量科技成果供给支撑现代化产业体系建设、强化以企业为主导的产学研协同创新、提高创新资源统筹配置效率、营造良好生态以及拓展深度融合空间。该官员指出，科技成果转化为现实生产力体现在催生新产业和推动产业转型上。因此，有必要及时将创新成果应用于产业和产业链。文件在这方面提出了三项措施：通过关键核心技术突破增强产业链自主可控能力，通过原创性和颠覆性科技创新培育壮大新兴产业和未来产业，以及通过应用先进技术转型升级传统产业。该官员强调了强化企业创新主体地位的重要意义。文件围绕这一目标提出了三项措施，即增强企业创新能力、加快科技企业发展以及促进创新主体之间更大协同。为改善创新资源配置，文件规定了促进科技、产业和金融良性循环、加强人才协调开发和利用以及建设集成创新平台等措施。

articles.fullText:
UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres on Thursday launched the first global assessment report on the implementation of the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, warning that global efforts remain off track to meet the 2030 targets despite widespread national commitments.
The Karen Demirchyan Sports and Concert Complex – the venue of the COP17 to the CBD, in Yerevan, Armenia, October 15, 2026. 
The State of Biodiversity Action report, released in the Armenian capital of Yerevan ahead of the 17th meeting of the Conference of the Parties (COP17) to the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD), evaluates collective progress under the landmark framework adopted in December 2022, which sets out 23 targets to halt and reverse biodiversity loss by 2030 and four long-term goals for 2050.
According to the report, nearly 90% of the CBD's 196 Parties have established national biodiversity targets, close to 60% have developed national biodiversity strategies and action plans, and over 70% have submitted national reports. Indigenous peoples and local communities, subnational governments, businesses and civil society organizations have also registered around 5,000 commitments.
However, such widespread engagement has not yet translated into sufficient progress. None of the 23 global targets presents a fully positive picture, and fewer than half of the national targets assessed by Parties are currently on track, the report found.
While national targets address an average of 22 of the 23 global targets, many fail to cover their full scope. For instance, far fewer countries have committed to reducing harmful subsidies under Target 18 than promoting positive incentives, and current national pledges under Target 3 fall well short of the goal to conserve 30% of land and sea by 2030.
The report identified gaps in financing and other means of implementation, whole-of-government and whole-of-society action, as well as data and knowledge needed to track progress. Targets requiring action beyond environment ministrie, including business action, sustainable consumption, harmful incentives and finance, are among those lagging furthest behind.
"The report shows that many of the critical elements of progress, including finance, capacity, cooperation and data, are still missing in action," Guterres said. "Nature won't thrive on good intentions."
The UN chief called for greater financial and technical support, particularly for developing countries, the reform of harmful subsidies, nature-positive investment and stronger integration of biodiversity across public policies and budgets.
"The very biodiversity we depend on needs tangible progress, not more promises," Inger Andersen, executive director of the UN Environment Programme, said in the report's foreword, urging immediate action to overcome implementation challenges.
The report will inform the first global review of collective progress under the framework at COP17, scheduled for October 19 through 30 in Yerevan.

articles.fullText:
China on Monday issued a guideline to boost financial support for building international science and technology centers in Beijing (Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region), Shanghai (the Yangtze River Delta), and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA).
The guideline, released by the People's Bank of China (PBOC) along with ten other departments, aims to build a financial service system that better matches the core functions and international positioning of the three innovation hubs.
By 2030, the country aims to establish a sound full-chain financial service system for technological innovation, achieve a "notable increase" in the proportion of direct financing, and basically form a pattern of integrated financial services in the three regions, according to the guideline.
Among the specific measures, the guideline calls for improving foreign exchange business facilitation policies for qualified foreign limited partners (QFLP), a move that is expected to facilitate overseas institutions' equity investment in China.
It also vows to make cross-border fund management simpler for multinational tech companies and for Chinese firms funding their overseas R&D centers.
The document sets out differentiated priorities for each region. The Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region will focus on original innovation and coordinated regional innovation, with stronger financial support for major science and technology infrastructure.
The Yangtze River Delta will leverage its industrial cluster advantages to build a technology finance ecosystem featuring multi-party participation and shared benefits.
The GBA will develop an open technology finance system, with an emphasis on deepening high-level financial interaction and regulatory alignment among Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao.
The guideline also stresses building risk prevention and control mechanisms to firmly guard against systemic financial risks.
Speaking at the Annual Conference of Financial Street Forum 2026 in Beijing on Monday, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng said that building the three international sci-tech innovation centers is a major strategy of the central authorities. Pan highlighted that the central bank will push for greater pilot efforts in the three regions in areas such as relending, the bond market's "sci-tech board" and cross-border investment and financing.
The country's 14th Five-Year Plan (2021-2025) called for supporting the initiative of making Beijing, Shanghai, and the GBA international centers for science and technology innovation, a goal that has guided progress over the past five years.
The expansion of the Beijing and Shanghai centers into the wider Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and the Yangtze River Delta, respectively, marks a shift from single-city breakthroughs toward coordinated regional development, a direction set out at the 2025 Central Economic Work Conference.

长三角地区将发挥产业集群优势，构建多方参与、利益共享的科技金融生态体系。粤港澳大湾区将发展开放的科技金融体系，重点深化广东、香港和澳门之间的高水平金融互动和监管对接。指导意见还强调建立风险防控机制，坚决防范系统性金融风险。中国人民银行行长潘功胜周一在北京举行的2026金融街论坛年会上表示，建设三个国际科技创新中心是中央的重大战略。潘功胜强调，央行将推动三个区域在再贷款、债券市场“科技板”以及跨境投融资等领域加大试点力度。国家“十四五”规划（2021-2025年）提出支持北京、上海和粤港澳大湾区建设国际科技创新中心的倡议，这一目标指导了过去五年的进展。北京和上海中心分别扩展至更广泛的京津冀地区和长三角地区，标志着从单一城市突破转向区域协同发展，这是2025年中央经济工作会议确定的方向。

articles.fullText:
The International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) will hold its 94th General Assembly in China's Hong Kong Special Administrative Region from November 30 to December 3, with China as host and the Hong Kong Police Force coordinating local preparations.
Representatives from Interpol's 196 member countries are expected to attend the gathering to address transnational crime, strengthen international police cooperation and shape the organization's strategic priorities.
In an interview ahead of the event, Interpol Secretary General Valdecy Urquiza said the assembly would consider endorsing the Silver Notice mechanism following a two-year pilot.
The mechanism would help police identify and locate criminal assets across jurisdictions, supporting subsequent seizure and repatriation through established judicial procedures. Targeting criminal finances, he explained, was essential to preventing organized crime groups from rebuilding their operations.
Artificial intelligence will also feature in the discussions. Urquiza said Interpol was helping police understand AI-related crime, apply the technology to investigations and develop frameworks for its responsible use.
He also stressed the importance of maintaining neutral channels for police cooperation and information sharing, regardless of diplomatic relations between countries. Describing Hong Kong as a hub for finance, trade and digital services, he said the city provided an ideal setting for discussions on cooperation and the future of law enforcement.
Chow Yat-ming, commissioner of police of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government, identified scams and financial investigations as priorities for Hong Kong's international engagement. He said the force would use the assembly to strengthen existing partnerships, establish new contacts and pursue bilateral discussions.
Hong Kong would also seek closer cooperation with Interpol on training and capacity building through the forthcoming Hong Kong International Academy of Policing. Chow said this would provide opportunities to share expertise and learn from overseas counterparts.
Preparations involve a whole-of-government effort, supported by exercises covering transport, logistics and other operational arrangements. Chow also said the assembly would provide a safe and secure platform for international cooperation while showcasing Hong Kong's hospitality, policing capabilities and the successful implementation of "one country, two systems."

国际刑事警察组织（国际刑警组织）将于11月30日至12月3日在中国香港特别行政区举行第94届大会，由中国担任东道主，香港警务处负责协调本地筹备工作。预计来自国际刑警组织196个成员国的代表将出席此次会议，共同应对跨国犯罪、加强国际警务合作并塑造该组织的战略优先事项。在大会前夕接受采访时，国际刑警组织秘书长瓦尔德西·乌尔基萨表示，大会将考虑在两年试点后正式认可“银色通报”机制。该机制将帮助警方跨司法管辖区识别和定位犯罪资产，支持通过既定司法程序进行后续查封和返还。他解释说，打击犯罪资金对于防止有组织犯罪集团重建其运作至关重要。

人工智能也将成为讨论议题。乌尔基萨表示，国际刑警组织正在帮助警方了解与人工智能相关的犯罪，将这项技术应用于调查工作，并制定负责任使用该技术的框架。他还强调，无论国家间外交关系如何，保持警务合作和信息共享的中立渠道至关重要。他将香港描述为金融、贸易和数字服务中心，并表示这座城市为有关合作和执法未来的讨论提供了理想场所。香港特别行政区政府警务处处长周一鸣将诈骗和金融调查确定为香港国际交往的优先事项。

他表示，警队将利用此次大会加强现有伙伴关系、建立新联系并开展双边讨论。香港还将通过即将成立的香港国际警务学院，寻求与国际刑警组织在培训和能力建设方面更紧密的合作。周一鸣表示，这将为分享专业知识和向海外同行学习提供机会。筹备工作涉及全政府层面的努力，并辅以涵盖交通、物流和其他运营安排的演练。周一鸣还表示，大会将为国际合作提供安全可靠的平台，同时展示香港的待客之道、警务能力以及“一国两制”的成功实践。
